name: Payment Category Purpose 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of transaction that resulted in the payment.

CORT.name: Trade Settlement Payment
CORT.definition: Transaction is related to settlement of a trade, eg a foreign exchange deal or a securities transaction.

SALA.name: Salary Payment
SALA.definition: Transaction is the payment of salaries.

TREA.name: Treasury Payment
TREA.definition: Transaction is related to treasury operations.

CASH.name: Cash Management Transfer
CASH.definition: Transaction is a general cash management instruction.

DIVI.name: Dividend
DIVI.definition: Transaction is the payment of dividends.

GOVT.name: Government Payment
GOVT.definition: Transaction is a payment to or from a government department.

INTE.name: Interest
INTE.definition: Transaction is the payment of interest.

LOAN.name: Loan
LOAN.definition: Transaction is related to the transfer of a loan to a borrower.

PENS.name: Pension Payment
PENS.definition: Transaction is the payment of pension.

SECU.name: Securities
SECU.definition: Transaction is the payment of securities.

SSBE.name: Social Security Benefit
SSBE.definition: Transaction is a social security benefit, ie payment made by a government to support individuals.

SUPP.name: Supplier Payment
SUPP.definition: Transaction is related to a payment to a supplier.

TAXS.name: Tax Payment
TAXS.definition: Transaction is the payment of taxes.

TRAD.name: Trade
TRAD.definition: Transaction is related to the payment of a trade transaction.

VATX.name: Value Added Tax Payment
VATX.definition: Transaction is the payment of value added tax.

HEDG.name: Hedging
HEDG.definition: Transaction is related to the payment of a hedging operation.

INTC.name: Intra Company Payment
INTC.definition: Transaction is an intra-company payment, ie, a payment between two companies belonging to the same group.

WHLD.name: With Holding
WHLD.definition: Transaction is the payment of withholding tax.
